core.headline: Detached cottage by the River Beult in Yalding
core.listing:
Mill Cottage is a detached three-bedroom cottage dating from around 1850, set on Riverside Lane in Yalding. The garden extends to the riverbank of the River Beult, and the property has a driveway for parking.

The ground floor comprises two reception rooms. One reception room has a wood-burning stove and exposed beams. The kitchen is fitted with a range of units.

On the first floor are three bedrooms and two bathrooms.

The garden runs to the riverbank of the River Beult.

Yalding is a village with a pub and primary school.

The property is offered for sale at offers in excess of £575,000 and is freehold. Council Tax Band E (Maidstone Borough Council). EPC rating E. Construction is standard. Electricity and water are mains-supplied; water is metered. Sewerage is via a septic tank. Heating is oil-fired central heating. Broadband: FTTC. Mobile signal: good outdoor coverage on major networks. The ground floor flooded from the River Beult in December 2013 and February 2020; flood doors and non-return valves were fitted in 2021; the property is insured through a Flood Re-backed policy. Building safety, restrictions, rights and easements, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield or mining issues are none known.
core.summary: Detached cottage dating from around 1850 with a wood-burning stove, exposed beams and a garden to the riverbank of the River Beult in Yalding, a village with a pub and primary school. Driveway parking.
